tasks.short: Negotiate and arrange freight transport with a carrier

steps.what: Write the goods, places and date for this transport
List freight companies whose rate matches that transport
Negotiate space and price with the freight company
Send the agreed freight booking to that company

tasks.design: She still writes the transport brief and negotiates space and price with the freight company. The {OPS_SYSTEM} only lists rate-card rows that match that brief. It sends the booking she already agreed, and a later change to price or date voids that release.
tasks.previous_blocker: The comparable rates sat in the same screens as the call, and the booking message was typed again after she had already agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A rate card already in the {OPS_SYSTEM} can be filtered by lane, weight and date, and the tender can send only the version she agreed.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the company has space, the price she will accept, and a carrier that refuses the tender.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the carrier will actually take, and she decides the price and the pickup window.

ambition.what: Ask a second freight company before the cutoff

tasks.altitude: She still negotiates every booking. She no longer hunts the rate card by hand, and she still releases the tender herself.

reach.task: Book a carrier for a customer shipment
reach.learn: How the agreed price and date are written so the tender sends only that version

evidence.claim: Filtering a rate card the firm already keeps by lane, weight and date is a query. It does not negotiate space or price. Model knowledge, grade E1.
A log of which person released a booking records who did what. Dutch works-council consent applies to that kind of log before it is switched on.

assumptions: The transport brief fields are goods, origin, destination, weight, ready date and any must-arrive time. She writes them in the first step. A missing field stays off the rate list until she adds it.
The rate card already lives in the operations system. Listing matching rows is a setting on that card. Carrier-system runtime is not her time.
She may release a booking that matches the terms she just negotiated. The send uses that agreed version only. A later change to price or date voids it.
Comparing options during the call is already in the negotiation step and is not deducted again. The incremental hours are refused tenders she rebooks by phone after the send.
unknowns: Whether a transport supervisor must release bookings above a value she does not hold today.
research_questions: What share of her bookings close on the phone with no separate tender message afterwards?

already_counted.description: She compares the freight options while she negotiates, and that time stays in the call.

incremental.description: She rebooks by phone when a carrier refuses the tender after it was sent.

approvals.approved_version: agreed freight terms the cargo agent released

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On lanes with no rate-card row the list saves nothing, and a booking agreed only on the phone has no second message to send. Those weeks keep most of the call.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose the shipment method and prepare the shipping documents

steps.what: Read the customer order into shipment fields

loop.purpose: Turn a free-text customer order into shipment fields.
loop.output: Goods description, piece count, weight, origin, destination and customer.
loop.check: The goods description means the same commodity as the order, and the weight and places are the ones written, not merely a customer id or a postcode.
loop.stop: A required field is missing, the goods line does not match the customer master, or the read is unsure.
loop.why_not_simpler: The order is free text, so a fixed form cannot read it, and a person must see the unsure ones.

steps.what: Check those shipment fields against the order
Propose a shipment method from the rate card
Change the shipment method for special cargo
Prepare the bill of lading and the invoice
Check charges and goods on those shipping documents
Send the corrected bill of lading and invoice

tasks.design: A bounded read on the {EMAIL} order fills shipment fields, and she checks that the goods, weight and places still mean that order. The {OPS_SYSTEM} proposes a method from the rate card and drafts the bill of lading and the invoice only after she accepts the method. She corrects charges and the goods line, then the system sends that corrected version. A later edit voids the release.
tasks.previous_blocker: The order arrived as free text, and the bill was typed again from the same facts. A wrong goods line is a legal document, not a typo to auto-file.
tasks.enabler_now: A transport system can read an order into fields and create the consignment note from the record she has checked. The rate card can propose a method only where a row matches.
tasks.still_hard: Special cargo, a date the card cannot meet, and a goods line that does not mean the order.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the method when the cargo is special, and she stops a bill whose goods line is wrong.

ambition.what: Issue the shipping documents the day the order is complete

tasks.altitude: She still chooses the method for special cargo and still releases every bill and invoice. She no longer retypes a clean order or fills the same fields into each document.

reach.task: Classify the goods on this shipment for customs
reach.learn: Which goods line on the bill still needs a person to classify it

evidence.claim: Qargo reads PDF orders into fields.
The Qargo case on FCE Transport reports order entry from 3-4 minutes to about 1 per job. No period is stated.
Qargo with TransFollow creates and signs the electronic consignment note inside the transport system.
The Qargo case on Mark Huisman Logistics reports invoicing time from 10 hours a week to 30 minutes after go-live on 1 January 2026.
A vendor customs case reports brokers left the top code suggestion unchanged 87 percent of the time, so this task does not auto-file a tariff code.
Authorities must accept data from a certified electronic freight platform from 9 July 2027.
On some foreign legs the driver may still need a printed consignment note.

assumptions: The read writes goods description, piece count, weight, origin, destination and customer. She checks that the goods line means the order. An unsure read stops for her.
The rate card proposes a method only when lane, weight and date match a row. Special cargo and a date the card cannot meet stay her decision in the change step.
Tariff codes are not proposed and not filed here. A brokerage clerk owns them. The cited acceptance of unchecked code suggestions is why.
The document draft, her correction, and the send are separate. The send uses the corrected bill and invoice only. A change after release voids it.

Orders the read cannot parse, which she types in full, and bills a carrier rejects after send, are the incremental hours. The field check, the method change and the document check are already counted and are not deducted again.
Where a foreign leg still needs a printed consignment note, that preparation stays inside her document check and is not claimed as saved.
unknowns: What share of orders already arrive as fields in the operations system, and whether the invoice is issued there or in the finance system.
research_questions: What share of her orders are free text, and what share of bills still leave as a printed note?

already_counted.description: Checking the fields, changing the method for special cargo, and checking the documents stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: She retypes orders the read cannot parse, and she redoes a bill a carrier rejects after send.

approvals.approved_version: corrected shipping documents the cargo agent released

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the order is already fields, the read saves nothing. When a foreign driver still needs a printed note, she still prepares that copy. Both keep her checks in full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Track delivery progress of open shipments

steps.what: List open shipments and add any missing reference
Pull the delivery milestone for each open shipment
Decide the chase when delivery progress has stopped
Call the carrier about delivery of that shipment

tasks.design: She keeps the open list and types a reference the booking does not hold. The {OPS_SYSTEM} pulls a delivery milestone from the carrier or port feed for each reference. She still decides which stop needs a chase, and she still makes that call. No status message goes to the client unless she places the call.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each carrier showed progress on its own screen, and a missing reference meant she could not tell a late shipment from a quiet one.
tasks.enabler_now: Where a carrier or port already publishes a milestone, that event can land on the shipment she listed. The call stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: A feed that is empty, a milestone that is wrong, and what to say to the carrier or the client.
tasks.human_edge: She decides that a stop is really late, and she asks the carrier for the next move.

ambition.what: Chase a shipment the hour its delivery milestone stops

tasks.altitude: She still judges exceptions and still calls. She no longer refreshes every carrier screen for shipments that already publish a milestone.

reach.task: Tell the client where the shipment is
reach.learn: Which delivery milestone means she should call, and which one she can leave

evidence.claim: A carrier status feed can write a milestone against a shipment reference the firm already stores. It does not replace the call when the feed is empty. Model knowledge, grade E1.
Portbase shows import status for sea freight through Rotterdam.

assumptions: The tracking contract is shipment id, carrier and reference, already on the booking. She adds a missing reference in the list step, and that typing keeps its time.
A milestone is a status the carrier or port already publishes. No feed means she still calls. The call is not shortened.
The machine does not send a status note to the client. Telling the client is her call.
Lookups she still does when a feed fails are the incremental hours. Deciding the chase and placing the call are already counted and are not deducted again.
unknowns: Which of her carriers publish a milestone for the lanes she actually runs.
research_questions: What share of her open shipments have a carrier or port status she can pull, against a screen she still opens?

already_counted.description: Listing missing references, deciding the chase and calling the carrier stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: She looks a shipment up by hand when the status feed is empty or wrong.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week of carriers with no status feed saves almost none of the refresh. The chase call stays on every late shipment either way.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise clients on transportation and payment methods

steps.what: Write the client's lane, date and payment question
List transportation methods and payment terms that fit
Advise the client which method and payment to use

tasks.design: She still takes the question and still advises the client. The {OPS_SYSTEM} lists transportation methods and payment terms that match the lane and the terms already on that client's account. She says which one to use. Nothing is sent to the client except by her in the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The modes and the payment terms sat on different screens, so she often advised from the one she could remember on the call.
tasks.enabler_now: Lane, date and the payment question are enough to list rows the account already holds. The recommendation stays her conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A client who wants a date the card cannot meet, and explaining who carries the cost.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the client will actually accept, and she recommends one method and one way to pay.

ambition.what: Name the payment method on every advice call

tasks.altitude: She still advises every client. She no longer hunts payment terms during the call when they are already on the account. She does not gain a right to send a quote she has not said.

reach.task: Explain how duty will be paid on this shipment
reach.learn: Which payment term is already on the account, and which one she must still say herself

evidence.claim: Payment terms already stored on a client account can be listed beside modes on the rate card. The advice itself stays a conversation. Model knowledge, grade E1.

assumptions: The advice request fields are lane, goods, date and the payment question. She writes them while she listens. Prepaid, collect and a duty account already sit on the client record in the operations system. If they do not, she says so in the conversation and that time stays.

The list does not advise and does not send. Lanes with no rate row, which she still prices by phone outside the list, are the incremental hours. The conversation is already counted and is not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether she also sends a written quote after the call, or the advice is only spoken.
research_questions: What share of advice calls already have the payment terms on the client record?

already_counted.description: Hearing the question and advising the client stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: She still prices by phone when the lane has no rate row to list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On calls where the account has no payment terms, and on lanes with no rate row, the list saves nothing. The advice conversation stays either way.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still negotiates freight, chooses the method for special cargo, advises the client, and releases every booking and every bill. Less of the week goes to retyping orders, filling documents and refreshing status screens.
skills_to_grow: Write goods, weight, places and the cutoff on the transport brief before any rate list.
Reject a shipping document whose goods line does not mean the order.
Chase a shipment only after its delivery milestone is late or missing.
role.ambitious_version: The tool does not negotiate space, choose a method for special cargo, or advise the client. It does not send a booking or a bill she has not released. A status note to a client waits until she has named the chase.
